name: move the shift to the current quotient each round
mechanism: run the shifted-solve iteration but, after each round, replace the shift by the current vector's own estimate of its eigenvalue (the quotient of the two inner products); convergence becomes cubic near a solution

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Rayleigh quotient iteration' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Linear algebra:

fails_when: which eigenvalue it finds depends on the start
